notes.title: The first part of the game «Sinful Soul» game is released on Steam!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of the first part of our new game «Sinful Soul» on Steam! Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you an immersive and exciting gaming experience that we're sure you'll love.


 Our game is a thrilling erotic novella in a cyberpunk world filled with danger and intrigue. You'll take on the role of an ordinary office worker who finally gets a chance to escape from the absorbing routine into the world of luxury and temptation. In our game, you will also meet three beautiful girls, each with a unique character and appearance.

We are waiting for you to play our game and leave your feedback ❤

 🔸 We also plan to release new chapters of the novel as the project develops further.

You can also join our Discord server where we will post all the latest news about the game: https://discord.gg/SAR6Cswj
